svg.aria-label: Terminal recording of the four Taskflow stages. taskflow-plan feature-abs explores the repositories and writes eleven planning documents; taskflow-review feature-abs verifies thirty-one claims and applies four corrections; taskflow-tasks feature-abs writes five immutable task specs in three conflict-safe groups; taskflow-execute feature-abs --parallel=4 --review=high runs them in parallel until all five are merged with CI green.
